'''Illegal races''' were commonly held in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[garbage pit]]. A [[Tunnel master]] would oversee the race. The contestants were required to work their way down through the levels of flying trash canisters and grab a scale off one of the giant [[garbage worm]]s. Then they would work their way back up and show their scale to the [[Greeter]]. Whoever was the first one to show their scale won.
